basics.name: Delina Sheikhrobat
basics.label: Civil Engineering Graduate — BIM, Sustainability & Automation
basics.summary: I am a Civil Engineering graduate from the University of Tehran, interested in the integration of Building Information Modeling (BIM), sustainability, automation, and emerging technologies in construction management. My interests focus on using digital tools such as Dynamo and AI to improve design workflows, support sustainable building practices, and explore technology-driven innovation in the construction industry.

work.name: University of Tehran
highlights: Mentored undergraduate students through core BIM workflows across the 3D modeling, 4D scheduling/animation, and 5D cost estimation dimensions.
Supported students in Autodesk Revit for parametric 3D modeling.
Guided students in Autodesk Navisworks for model coordination, clash detection, and 4D construction sequencing.
Guided students in Microsoft Project to develop construction schedules and connect them with BIM models.
Supported students in quantity take-off and cost estimation workflows.

work.name: VR & Computer Graphics Lab, Department of Civil Engineering, University of Tehran
highlights: Designed and developed immersive virtual-reality environments in Unity for transportation research.
Translated real-world road and traffic scenarios into interactive 3D simulations.
Integrated VR environments with head-mounted displays to conduct controlled experiments.
Studied participant behavior and decision-making in simulated traffic scenarios.
Collaborated with faculty researchers to define experimental scenarios and improve environments based on pilot testing feedback.
